_comment: What the Nightjet fare check (scripts/probe-nj-fares.mjs, 'Probe Nightjet fares' workflow, label a PR run-probes) re-asks nightjet.com about. A pull_request run has no workflow inputs, so the sample lives here.

disputed: the nights the owner checked in ÖBB's shop, asked first and reported with a verdict — [{ "train": "NJ 466", "date": "2026-10-20", "shop": { "price": 119.9, "product": "Sparschiene", "compartment": "Liegewagen 6er", "seenAt": "2026-10-11T09:30+02:00" }, "note": "grid cell said 59.9" }]. compartment says which class the price is for (couchette/Liege… or sleeper/Schlaf…/bed); a night not after today is skipped with a note.

The rest of the sample is chosen by the probe: anomalies (couchette at or below the seat price, couchette at seat level ≤ seatLevelMax, bed below couchette, bed only, partnerTrains off the .9 ladder; anomaliesPerKind each, spread across trains), coupledPairs on the same night (nightsPerCoupledPair each), perLeadBucket priced nights per lead bucket (1–3, 4–7, 8–14, 15–21, 22–42 days) on distinct trains by a hash seeded with the date, and repeats of those asked again at least repeatMinGapSeconds later.
maxRequests caps every request to nightjet.com, robots.txt included, spacingSeconds apart; what the cap drops is logged.

shop: the ÖBB shop step — robots.txt, then the anonymous token (where a block will show), and only on a 200 the timetable and offers for maxTrainNights nights, spacingSeconds apart, honest User-Agent and functional headers only. A block ends it; it is never retried or worked around.
